notes: One login with each way in, before and after script:perfect (+300 s).

steps.label: planted key: log in to web-01
steps.run: ssh -i /root/.replay/k1 -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no mfischer@{target} 'cat /etc/hostname' > /dev/null

steps.label: copied staff key: log in to web-01
steps.run: ssh -i /root/.replay/n -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no nvega@{target} 'cat /etc/hostname' > /dev/null

steps.label: deploy password: log in to web-01
steps.run: SSHPASS='{secret:dpw}' sshpass -e ssh -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1 deploy@{target} 'cat /etc/hostname' > /dev/null

steps.label: planted key again
steps.run: ssh -i /root/.replay/k1 -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no mfischer@{target} 'cat /etc/hostname' > /dev/null

steps.label: copied staff key again
steps.run: ssh -i /root/.replay/n -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o PasswordAuthentication=no nvega@{target} 'cat /etc/hostname' > /dev/null

steps.label: deploy password again
steps.run: SSHPASS='{secret:dpw}' sshpass -e ssh -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1 deploy@{target} 'cat /etc/hostname' > /dev/null
